discriminating_logic: MMDS1–3 manifest in neonates/infants with fulminant lactic acidosis, early pulmonary hypertension, cystic leukodystrophy, and early death, whereas MMDS9B presents primarily as progressive sensorial neuropathy without catastrophic infantile systemic collapse.
